source_evidence.label: OPH writing levels 3/4 primary criterion PDF page 2
source_evidence.claim: Holistic judgement; level 3 everyday coherent and comprehensible writing; level 4 more flexible, elaborated, register-adapted writing; not official arithmetic scoring.

source_evidence.label: SOLKI keskitaso kirjoittaminen
source_evidence.claim: Historical sample says three different writing tasks and shows email and opinion examples; paper handwriting instructions are NOT digital editor instructions; exact future distribution unknown.

source_evidence.label: OPH after YKI test
source_evidence.claim: Qualified language teachers/assessors do assessment under criteria, certificates automatically issued only after ratings; automation not writing grading.

source_evidence.label: OPH digital pilot announcement
source_evidence.claim: Digital YKI computer pilot 7 November 2026 for Finnish intermediate (future as of check); does not publish text editor UX.

source_evidence.label: OPH before test/demos
source_evidence.claim: Four ungraded Inspera demos; mixed historic paper-day instructions; no manual digital demo inspected.

source_evidence.label: Council of Europe CEFR writing production and interaction
source_evidence.claim: Outcome descriptors, not actual official YKI editor controls or scoring formula.

source_evidence.label: Internal prior human-anchored Finnish study, reusing evidence
source_evidence.claim: Keep the existing R04 grading framework rather than competing new arbitrary weights.

source_evidence.label: AI-assisted L2 writing feedback 2026 meta, 19 studies N=11875
source_evidence.claim: Modest overall d=.271 with heterogeneity; stronger engagement than cognitive outcome; cannot infer Finnish YKI pass improvement.

source_evidence.label: Algorithm-based writing feedback 2026, 33 studies
source_evidence.claim: Surface/deep writing skills can improve; surface maintenance null in reviewed comparisons; transfer to novel tasks small, so evaluate day14/30.

source_evidence.label: Feedback L1/L2/FL learners 2024
source_evidence.claim: Combined surface/deep feedback may benefit outcomes; context and interventions vary.

source_evidence.label: W3C UI Events composition lifecycle
source_evidence.claim: compositionstart/end, beforeinput/input event order matters; IME behaviors must be tested, not assumed.

source_evidence.label: WCAG 2.2
source_evidence.claim: Keyboard access, status messages, time-limit rules and understandable navigation; exact YKI accommodation remains separate first-party decision.

acceptance_gates.description: Three historical canonical families covered by original licensed S2-reviewed Finnish tasks (not copied official examples)
Two independent Finnish S2 teachers approve genre/recipient/purpose/required points and valid alternatives
Byte/Unicode-exact draft persisted and verified across reload and multi-tab conflict, with clear local save status
IME/Android ä/ö/copy/paste/keyboard and composition boundaries pass browser E2E
Deadline and finish state enforced transactionally, no final text post-commit mutation
No rubric hints, grammar correction, keys, template phrases or auto-drafting inside closed EXAM
Human calibrated holistic feedback only after sealed finish; no invented YKI 3/4 or numeric formula
Digital 2027 writing UI controls verified through OPH and authorized Inspera walkthrough; otherwise practice profile only
Personal writing retained/deleted/exported securely with accessible state announcements and privacy review
Independent day14/day30 new-genre/recipient transfer evaluated against matched baseline with blinded S2 raters

legal_policy: Do not copy historic official example task prompts or answer texts into product. Review rights of any external models. Retain only user-authorized local responses unless separate consent and security review.
human_rating_plan: Use OPH holistic levels for criterion reference, two trained S2 teachers with blind independent reviews and adjudication; language-quality analysis not equal to official certificate.
feedback_policy: Only after durable finish, emphasize communicative task, genre and recipient, coherence, wording then selected grammar; self-repair and new unseen task. Any AI-assisted output clearly formative and uncalibrated.
